pokemon.physicalDescription: A yellow rodent-like Pokémon displaying persistent electrical discharge from both cheek pouches.

anomalousProperties.summary: The specimen absorbs electrical energy from an area far beyond normal Pikachu capacity, including electrical activity within living nervous systems.

properties.name: Wide-Area Electrical Absorption
properties.description: When agitated, the specimen draws electrical charge from all active sources within a radius of approximately 300 m.

hazards.description: Can disable site infrastructure and cause cardiac arrest in exposed personnel.

containment.specialContainmentProcedures: SCP-PKMN-025 is to be housed in a grounded Faraday enclosure with independent mechanical life-support systems.
containment.handlingProcedures: Personnel must use non-electronic protective equipment and maintain a minimum distance of 10 m during feeding and examination.
containment.emergencyProcedures: In the event of anomalous discharge, isolate the chamber through manual mechanical locks and evacuate the surrounding wing.

description: SCP-PKMN-025 is an adult Pikachu with electrical abilities significantly exceeding known biological limits.
